name: LCS latent colour space edits
plain: Converts denoised to raw VAE space, cuts it into patches, and edits those patches: by adding an edit vector for sharpness, or by intervening in a three-axis projection for colour. Then it converts back. Only the sharpen path and the head of the colour path were read.
math:
Sharpen: patches+=m·ev, inside the step window.
Colour head: projection=(patches−μ)B, 3 axes from a stored basis. Adjustments after that not read. Anchor node: adaptive drift correction, docstring only.
label: from code
